|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-65-Daughter_Of_Skywalker-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip show the original text (see [[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “If in hand, may place her under Reserve Deck. May be deployed instead of Luke by Mind What You Have Learned (that card then targets Leia instead of Luke for remainder of game). May ▼ Reflection. Immune to attrition < 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-65-Daughter_Of_Skywalker.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-daughterofskywalker-pre.gif]]) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): “be deployed instead of Luke” became “be targeted instead of Luke”. The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed this text, with the ▼ written out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”<ref name="cl-1261_63-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) gives the change<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-5; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints it<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=7, page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If in hand, may place her under Reserve Deck. May be targeted instead of Luke by Mind What You Have Learned (that card then targets Leia instead of Luke for remainder of game). May ▼ Reflection. Immune to attrition < 4.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-65-Daughter_Of_Skywalker-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 8 October 2010, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook (so that Daughter Of Skywalker gets the Dagobah deployment modifier when deployed from the objective)<ref name="pcforum-p578615">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 8 October 2010 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=0#p578615 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
